lines.en: label beachvacation7:
scene chikasunset1
: Oh, hey!
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨！

lines.en: : I was wondering when you’d show up.
lines.zh: : 我还纳闷你什么时候才会露面呢。

lines.en: I make my way back to the beach after taking a short nap and immediately stumble upon Chika sitting on top of a picnic table, consumed by the light of the setting sun.
lines.zh: 我小睡了一会儿后回到海滩，迎面撞见Chika坐在野餐桌顶上，整个人被夕阳的光笼罩着。

lines.en: The laughter and conversation of some of the other girls can be heard off in the distance, but it doesn’t seem that any of them are aware of my presence yet.
lines.zh: 远处能听到几个女生的笑声和说话声，不过她们似乎还没察觉到我。

lines.en: I guess it wouldn’t hurt to spend a little time catching up with this girl since she’s just now getting here, though.
lines.zh: 不过既然她刚到，花点时间跟这丫头叙叙旧也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Hey. How’s Chinami?
lines.zh: : 嗨。千奈美还好吗？

lines.en: scene chikasunset2
: Good, good...Yumi’s gonna be heading back in a few minutes, so she doesn’t have to spend the night alone.
lines.zh: : 挺好的，挺好的……Yumi再过几分钟就回去了，所以她不用一个人过夜。

lines.en: : She was taking a nap when I left so, if we’re lucky, she might not experience the lack of company at all.
lines.zh: : 我来的时候她正在午睡，所以运气好的话，她可能根本不会察觉到没人陪。

lines.en: : I’m guessing bringing her along wasn’t in the cards, then?
lines.zh: : 看来带上她这事是不成了？

lines.en: scene chikasunset3
: Right...Too many girls close together...unknown inn...you know the deal.
lines.zh: : 嗯……太多女生挤在一起……陌生的旅馆……你懂的。

lines.en: : I can’t really do anything that would put her at risk...and even getting her here seemed damn near impossible.
lines.zh: : 我不能做任何会让她陷入危险的事……光是把她弄到这儿来就已经难如登天了。

lines.en: scene chikasunset4
: Besides, I wouldn’t want her wearing that silly dog mask for an entire weekend either.
lines.zh: : 再说我也不想让她整周末都戴着那张蠢狗面具。

lines.en: if mall15 == True:
: Yeah...I can’t imagine that would match well with her swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我实在想象不出那玩意儿跟她的泳衣要怎么搭。

lines.en: : Neither can I, Sensei...Neither can I.
lines.zh: : 我也想象不出啊，Sensei……我也想象不出。

lines.en: else:
: ...Dog mask?
lines.zh: : ……狗面具？

lines.en: : You’ll find out soon enough.
lines.zh: : 你很快就会知道的。

lines.en: : Either way, I’m glad I was able to make it out.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很高兴自己总算来了。

lines.en: : I love the beach. And this is the first time I’ve ever even been on vacation...even if it is only for a couple days.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢海滩。而且这也是我人生中第一次度假……哪怕只有两天。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad I’m here to experience it with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也很高兴能在这儿陪你一起经历。

lines.en: scene chikasunset5
: Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Me too...
lines.zh: : 我也是……

lines.en: A moment of silence goes by as the sun strays further and further from our eyes.
lines.zh: 一片沉默中，太阳离我们的视线越来越远。

lines.en: Within moments, it will disappear beyond the horizon, swapping places with its lunar counterpart and drenching the beach in blue.
lines.zh: 再过一会儿，它就要沉到地平线以下，与月亮交换位置，把整片海滩浸成蓝色。

lines.en: So amidst the dying sun, Chika and I-
lines.zh: 于是，在这残阳之中，我和Chika——

lines.en: scene chikasunset6
: Yeah, sorry to interrupt whatever the fuck is going on over here, but I’m heading out.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断你们这儿不知道在搞什么鬼，不过我要走了。

lines.en: : Can you give me the key?
lines.zh: : 能把钥匙给我吗？

lines.en: : You didn’t bring yours?
lines.zh: : 你没带自己的？

lines.en: : I forgot it. I’m kind of used to wearing more clothes than this, so you’re gonna need to cut me some slack this time.
lines.zh: : 我忘了。我平时穿的衣服可比这多，所以这次你就担待点吧。

lines.en: scene chikasunset7
: Well, did you at least enjoy your free time today?
lines.zh: : 那至少今天的自由时间你还玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : No. It was fucking exhausting.
lines.zh: : 不。累死我了。

lines.en: : It was hot as shit, I’m sweaty, and people kept trying to talk to me.
lines.zh: : 热得要死，我一身汗，还有人不停地来跟我搭话。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s normally how these things go.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这种事一般都这样。

lines.en: : Whatever. I just want to go home and sleep. Can you just give me the fucking key so I don’t have to deal with this anymore?
lines.zh: : 算了。我只想回家睡觉。你能不能把那该死的钥匙给我，让我别再受这罪了？

lines.en: : Last bus leaves in like twenty minutes and if I have to sleep in a room with eleven other girls I’ll literally just kill myself.
lines.zh: : 末班车大概二十分钟后开，要是让我跟另外十一个女生睡一间房，我干脆自杀算了。

lines.en: scene chikasunset8
: It's in my bag...
lines.zh: : 在我包里……

lines.en: : Which bag? You have like nine.
lines.zh: : 哪个包？你好像有九个。

lines.en: : The purple one. It’s with all the other girls' bags near the bathroom.
lines.zh: : 紫色的那个。和其他女生的包一起放在洗手间那边。

lines.en: : Cool, thanks.
lines.zh: : 行，谢了。

lines.en: : No problem. Anything else you need before you go?
lines.zh: : 不客气。走之前还需要什么吗？

lines.en: : There any food at the apartment? I haven’t eaten all day.
lines.zh: : 公寓里有吃的吗？我一整天都没吃东西。

lines.en: : Yeah. You can take whatever as long as you leave enough for Chinami to eat breakfast in the morning.
lines.zh: : 有。你随便拿，只要给千奈美留够明早的早饭就行。

lines.en: : Duh. Have fun being a fucking social butterfly or whatever it was.
lines.zh: : 废话。好好当你的社交蝴蝶去吧，管它叫什么。

lines.en: : Have a safe trip home, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 路上小心，Yumi。

lines.en: scene chikasunset9
: Yeah...
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: : See you.
lines.zh: : 回见。

lines.en: scene chikasunset10
Yumi turns away from us and heads toward the pavilion, reaching into Chika’s bag and pulling out her key to salvation.
lines.zh: Yumi转身朝凉亭走去，把手伸进Chika的包里，掏出了那把通向救赎的钥匙。

lines.en: She disappears into the bathroom with a white plastic bag in tow and gets dressed, coming out and walking toward the bus stop just a minute or two later.
lines.zh: 她拎着一个白色塑料袋走进洗手间换好衣服，一两分钟后出来，朝巴士站走去。

lines.en: The entire time, Chika and I don’t say anything.
lines.zh: 整个过程里，我和Chika一句话也没说。

lines.en: : Did you...see that just now?
lines.zh: : 你……看到刚才那一幕了吗？

lines.en: : See what? Her getting dressed?
lines.zh: : 看到什么？她换衣服？

lines.en: : Because I doubt I'd be able to see into the bathroom from here even if I-
lines.zh: : 因为就算我——我怀疑从这儿也看不到洗手间里面。

lines.en: scene chikasunset11
: No, doofus. The way she said goodbye to you.
lines.zh: : 不是啦，笨蛋。是她跟你道别的方式。

lines.en: : You mean with disdain and resentment?
lines.zh: : 你是说带着轻蔑和怨恨的那种？

lines.en: : I mean without being rude or telling you she’s going to rip your dick off.
lines.zh: : 我是说她没有出言不逊，也没说要把你的鸡巴扯下来。

lines.en: : Isn’t that like, a huge improvement?
lines.zh: : 这难道不是巨大的进步吗？

lines.en: : Oh...Yeah, I didn’t even notice that. That seems like a pretty big deal.
lines.zh: : 哦……是哦，我都没注意到。看来这确实是件大事。

lines.en: : I wonder if she’s doing okay?
lines.zh: : 不知道她还好吗？

lines.en: scene chikasunset12
: What was she like on her own? Did she just sort of...sit around and do nothing all day?
lines.zh: : 她一个人的时候是什么样？就那么……坐一整天什么也不干？

lines.en: : I haven’t been around for a good portion of it, but I think so.
lines.zh: : 我大部分时间没在她身边，不过我想是的。

lines.en: : Having Yumi on her own in a social setting probably isn’t the best idea right now.
lines.zh: : 现在让Yumi独自待在社交场合里，大概不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : That’s exactly why I was so insistent on her coming.
lines.zh: : 所以我才这么坚持要她来。

lines.en: : She needs to actually talk to people if she’s ever going to stop being so bitchy all the time.
lines.zh: : 她要是想改掉整天毒舌的毛病，就得真的跟人说话。

lines.en: : I’m kinda surprised she even came, to be honest. This was the first time she’s ever actually taken one of my suggestions.
lines.zh: : 说实话她能来我挺意外的。这还是她第一次真的听进去我的建议。

lines.en: scene chikasunset4
: Maybe she just wanted to see you?
lines.zh: : 说不定她只是想见你？

lines.en: : That is definitely not the reason. I only had one conversation with her today and it basically ended with her calling Futaba a beached whale.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是这个原因。我今天只跟她说过一次话，而且最后基本上以她骂二叶是搁浅的鲸鱼收场。

lines.en: scene chikasunset13
: Oh my fucking God! Are you kidding?! She's even doing that here?! On vacation?!
lines.zh: : 我操你大爷！你开玩笑吧？！她在这儿都这样？！度假的时候？！

lines.en: : I don’t know how many times I need to tell her to be nice to her! It’s fucking unbearable.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还得跟她说多少次让她对你友善点。真是受够了。

lines.en: : What the hell did Futaba even do?! She’s like, the nicest girl in class.
lines.zh: : 二叶到底做什么了？！她可是班上最温柔的女生了。

lines.en: : Beats me. Yumi quieted down in the end, though. Maybe even looked a little upset.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。不过Yumi最后安静下来了。甚至看起来有点低落。

lines.en: : I didn’t think much of it, though. Not going to spend time trying to cheer someone up who’s literally doing things to make themselves miserable in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我也没多想。我可不想花时间去哄一个本来就在自找苦吃的人。

lines.en: scene chikasunset14
: Wish I could do that...
lines.zh: : 我要是也能这样就好了……

lines.en: : I always feel like I need to cheer people up no matter what and it’s like, not even possible 90%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得不管怎样都得去哄别人开心，可90%%的情况下那根本不可能。

lines.en: : That’s life. Sometimes, you just need to let people tire themselves out through sadness.
lines.zh: : 这就是人生。有时候，你只能让人自己在悲伤里耗尽力气。

lines.en: : That's like, mega depressing.
lines.zh: : 这也太丧了吧。

lines.en: : Just try not to fall into the same slump as Yumi and you'll be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要你自己别掉进和Yumi一样的状态里就行。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I'll try.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: scene black
A few minutes go by as Chika and I make idle chit-chat about her job at the mall and her plans for tomorrow.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟里，我和Chika闲聊了她在商场的工作和明天的计划。

lines.en: Apparently, she isn’t much of a swimmer but loves the sun, so she’s going to be “decompressing” and sunbathing for the bulk of the day.
lines.zh: 她似乎不太会游泳，但很爱晒太阳，所以打算整天「放松解压」加日光浴。

lines.en: It sounds boring to me, but as long as I get to see her lounging around in her bathing suit, she’s free to do whatever she likes.
lines.zh: 这听起来挺无聊的，不过只要能看到她穿着泳衣懒洋洋地躺着，她爱干什么都行。

lines.en: Eventually, two more familiar faces wander into the frame and start heading our way, prompting Chika to hop off of the table and meet them.
lines.zh: 没多久，又两张熟悉的脸走进了画面，朝我们这边走来，Chika便从桌上跳下来迎了上去。

lines.en: scene chikasunset15
: Futaba, Sensei told me about Yumi and I just want to say I’m so, so sorry...
lines.zh: : 二叶，Sensei跟我说了Yumi的事，我只想说，真的非常非常对不起……

lines.en: : I honestly think you’re one of the cutest girls ever and I will never understand why she’s so mean to you. It makes zero sense.
lines.zh: : 我真的觉得你是全世界最可爱的女生之一，我永远不理解她为什么对你那么刻薄。完全说不通。

lines.en: : Oh...It’s okay. It’s not your fault.
lines.zh: : 哦……没事。不是你的错。

lines.en: scene chikasunset16
: It’s at least kind of my fault. I’m the one who talked her into coming and then she went and did something like that.
lines.zh: : 至少也算我一部分的错吧。是我把她劝来的，结果她就干了那种事。

lines.en: : If you ever need someone to help deal with her, please just let me know.
lines.zh: : 要是你需要有人帮你应付她，随时跟我说。

lines.en: : There’s obviously not much I can do to get her to stop, but I can at least pull her hair or something if she gets to be too annoying.
lines.zh: : 显然我没法让她停下，不过要是她太烦人，我至少能拽她头发什么的。

lines.en: scene chikasunset17
: Pull her hair?...
lines.zh: : 拽她头发？……

lines.en: scene chikasunset18
: It’s okay, Chika. Really.
lines.zh: : 没关系的，Chika。真的。

lines.en: : I’m getting a little better at dealing with things like that.
lines.zh: : 我现在应付这种事已经好一点了。

lines.en: scene chikasunset19
: Thanks to...a certain someone.
lines.zh: : 多亏了……某个人。

lines.en: : Who? Me?
lines.zh: : 谁？我？

lines.en: : Of course. You’ve done so much for my confidence in just a short time that it’s...almost kind of crazy.
lines.zh: : 当然是你。你在这么短的时间里为我的自信做了这么多，简直……有点疯狂。

lines.en: scene chikasunset20
: Really? This guy of all people? How does that work?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？偏偏是这家伙？怎么做到的？

lines.en: : Rin, I think you’re forgetting that I know things about you that I could ‘accidentally’ let slip at any moment.
lines.zh: : Rin，你是不是忘了，我可知道一些关于你的事，随时可能「不小心」说漏嘴。

lines.en: scene chikasunset21
: I take it back! Sensei is the greatest! So great! Such a cool dude!
lines.zh: : 我收回！Sensei是最棒的！超级棒！超酷的老兄！

lines.en: : What sort of things does Sensei know about you that I don’t, Rin?
lines.zh: : Sensei知道什么是我不知道的关于你的事呢，Rin？

lines.en: scene chikasunset22
: Nothing! He knows nothing!
lines.zh: : 没有！他什么都不知道！

lines.en: : Do I spy hearts in your eyes?
lines.zh: : 我好像在你眼里看到了爱心？

lines.en: : I don't even have eyes!
lines.zh: : 我连眼睛都没有！

lines.en: : I bet Sensei knows who you’re crushing on, doesn’t he?
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌Sensei知道你暗恋谁，对吧？

lines.en: scene chikasunset22r
: What?! Wh-Why would you ever think something like that?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你……你怎么会这么想？！

lines.en: : Cause I’m a girl, duh. We can smell these sorts of things from a mile away.
lines.zh: : 因为我是女生啊，废话。这种事我们一英里外就能闻出来。

lines.en: : We can?!
lines.zh: : 我们能？！

lines.en: : Well, I can, at least. And that face says it all.
lines.zh: : 至少我能。而且你那张脸已经说明一切了。

lines.en: : That's the face of a girl in love.
lines.zh: : 那就是恋爱中女孩的表情。

lines.en: scene chikasunset23
: Wow it’s...suddenly getting a lot hotter out here, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哇，外面突然……热了好多，是不是？

lines.en: : Hahahah...Wow! So hot! Maybe I need to sit down or...drink water or...sit down?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈……哇！好热！我可能得坐下来或者……喝点水或者……坐下来？

lines.en: : You said “sit down” twice.
lines.zh: : 你说了两次「坐下来」。

lines.en: : Sensei...would it be okay if I pulled you aside for a second? There’s something I want to talk about.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我能把你拉到一边说两句吗？有件事想跟你谈。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...yeah. We can do that.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……好啊。可以。

lines.en: : Great...thanks.
lines.zh: : 太好了……谢谢。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba walks with me toward the trees, leaving Chika and Rin behind to talk on their own...
lines.zh: 二叶和我朝树林走去，把Chika和Rin留在后面自己聊……

lines.en: scene chikasunset24
: Maybe it’s for the best if we let the two of them be alone for a little while, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 我们最好让她们两个单独待一会儿，你觉得呢？

lines.en: : You know, don't you?
lines.zh: : 你知道的吧？

lines.en: : Of course I know. Rin is basically my sister.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。Rin基本上就像我的姐妹。

lines.en: scene chikasunset25
: I've had my suspicions for a while, but...she's been making things a lot more obvious ever since high school started.
lines.zh: : 我早就有点怀疑了，不过……上高中之后她把这事表现得明显多了。

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure she's just...accepted that I know by now. But it's not like we've ever had a conversation or anything.
lines.zh: : 我敢说她现在已经……接受了「我知道」这件事。不过我们也从没谈过这些。

lines.en: scene chikasunset24
: I also...had a feeling you knew as well, given how close you two have become.
lines.zh: : 我也……觉得你知道，毕竟你们俩变得那么亲近。

lines.en: : Yeah well, like you said, it's not like she does a particularly good job of hiding it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就像你说的，她藏得确实不怎么样。

lines.en: : She really doesn’t...
lines.zh: : 她真的藏不住……

lines.en: : So I guess...the two of us will just hang out over here for a while and let them do their thing?
lines.zh: : 那么我想……我们两个就在这边待一会儿，让她们自己搞定？

lines.en: : Unless you have a problem spending time with me, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你不介意跟我待在一起。

lines.en: : I think I’ve made it quite apparent that I very much enjoy spending time with you.
lines.zh: : 我想我已经表达得很清楚了——我非常享受和你在一起的时光。

lines.en: : You have...but please try to keep it in your pants for now since we don’t know how long Rin will be able to last on her own.
lines.zh: : 你是表达得很清楚……不过现在还请先把持住，因为我们不知道Rin一个人能撑多久。

lines.en: : I will do my very best...
lines.zh: : 我会尽全力的……

lines.en: scene black
Meanwhile...
lines.zh: 与此同时……

lines.en: scene chikasunset26
Oh, how horrible it is to be unloved.
lines.zh: 不被爱，是多么可怕的事。

lines.en: To love those who can not understand.
lines.zh: 去爱那些无法理解的人。

lines.en: And to forgo the love of oneself in pursuit of that.
lines.zh: 并为此舍弃对自己的爱。

lines.en: All three gods disappear and leave yet another poor soul to fend for itself as the day becomes the night.
lines.zh: 三位神明尽数消失，又留下一个可怜的灵魂自生自灭，白昼化作黑夜。

lines.en: scene chikasunset27
: So, are you going to tell me who it is or am I going to have to guess?
lines.zh: : 所以，你是打算告诉我是谁，还是要我猜？

lines.en: : Umm...preferably neither.
lines.zh: : 嗯……最好两个都不要。

lines.en: : What? So Sensei can know but I can’t?
lines.zh: : 什么？所以Sensei能知道，我就不行？

lines.en: : Well...he kind of just found out in the heat of the moment...or whatever.
lines.zh: : 嗯……他算是……在情急之下自己发现的……之类的吧。

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
scene chikasunset28
: Wait...it’s not him is it?
lines.zh: : 等等……不会是他吧？

lines.en: scene chikasunset29
: Huh? No. I didn’t mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 哈？不是。我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : I meant that he just kind of found out on his own. It’s not like I planned on telling him or anything.
lines.zh: : 我是说他就是自己发现的。我又没打算告诉他什么的。

lines.en: : Oh okay, okay. Just making sure.
lines.zh: : 哦好好好。确认一下而已。

lines.en: scene chikasunset30
: In a sense, that’s kind of how he found out for me as well.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，他发现我的事也是这么个过程。

lines.en: : You...
: You have someone you...like?
lines.zh: : 你有……喜欢的人？

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : Why should I tell you when you won’t tell me, though?
lines.zh: : 可你不告诉我，我为什么要告诉你呢？

lines.en: scene chikasunset31
: My situation isn’t exactly normal...
lines.zh: : 我的情况不太寻常……

lines.en: : What, and mine is?
lines.zh: : 什么，我的就很寻常吗？

lines.en: : We can’t help who we fall in love with.
lines.zh: : 我们没法控制自己爱上谁。

lines.en: : Kinda like that one poem you wrote back in middle[school].
lines.zh: : 就像你初中[school]时写的那首诗。

lines.en: scene chikasunset32
: You...You remember that?!
lines.zh: : 你……你还记得那个？！

lines.en: : Of course I remember that. It was, like...one of the cutest poems I've ever heard.
lines.zh: : 当然记得。那是我听过的……最可爱的诗之一。

lines.en: scene chikasunset33
: And the way you got all nervous when the teacher made you recite it. Adorable. Top ten Rin moment.
lines.zh: : 还有老师让你当众朗诵时你紧张得要命的样子。太可爱了。Rin的名场面前十。

lines.en: : Why are you ranking my moments?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要给我的名场面排名啊？！

lines.en: scene chikasunset31
: Listen...the point is that I’m not going to judge you no matter who it is.
lines.zh: : 听着……重点是，不管对方是谁，我都不会评判你。

lines.en: : Yeah...I don’t know about that, Chika...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这我可说不好，Chika……

lines.en: : No, no. I mean it. I know you probably don’t think of me as a good friend or anything like that, but I’ve wanted to get closer to you ever since I heard that poem.
lines.zh: : 不，不。我是认真的。我知道你大概不觉得我是什么好朋友，不过从听到那首诗起，我就一直想跟你走近些。

lines.en: : I feel like you’ve got all these feelings you keep bottled up that are just dying to get out.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你心里憋着一大堆情绪，都快憋坏了。

lines.en: : Which probably sounds a little crazy since we’ve never really shared anything like that.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来可能有点怪，毕竟我们从来没有分享过这类事情。

lines.en: : But...I’ve always seen myself as a pretty good judge of character. And if you ever do want to open up to me a little more...I’d be happy to listen.
lines.zh: : 不过……我一直觉得自己看人很准。要是你哪天想跟我多敞开心扉一点……我很乐意听。

lines.en: scene chikasunset34
: Not sure if I’ll be able to tell you who I’m crushing on, though. That one’s kind of a big deal...
lines.zh: : 不过我也不确定会不会把我暗恋的人告诉你。那事有点重大……

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: So is mine.
lines.zh: : 我的也是。

lines.en: else:
scene chikasunset35
: Wait, is it that Molly girl who just transferred in?
lines.zh: : 等等，是那个刚转学来的Molly吗？

lines.en: : Molly?! Why would you think that?!
lines.zh: : Molly？！你怎么会这么想？！

lines.en: : I don’t know. I saw you two talking earlier and it looked like you were really close.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我看到你们俩之前在聊天，看起来关系很好的样子。

lines.en: : We are close! But like, not that close!
lines.zh: : 我们关系是好啊！但也不是那种好！

lines.en: : We just play games together and work at the same place.
lines.zh: : 我们只是一起打游戏，还在同一个地方打工。

lines.en: : Molly’s a great friend but like...totally not my type.
lines.zh: : Molly是个好朋友，但……完全不是我的菜。

lines.en: scene chikasunset36
: Oh? What is your type, then?
lines.zh: : 哦？那你喜欢什么类型？

lines.en: : Well, that’s...kind of a secret too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也……算是秘密吧。

lines.en: : Really? You won’t even tell me what kind of person you’re into?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？你连喜欢什么类型都不肯告诉我？

lines.en: : I get not wanting to come out and say who you like, but I’m pretty sure you can at least tell me who you’d generally go for.
lines.zh: : 你不想直接说出喜欢谁我能理解，但你总该能告诉我你一般会喜欢什么样的人吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...I mean, I guess. But it’ll probably sound really weird.
lines.zh: : 呃……我想也是。不过说出来可能会很怪。

lines.en: : Why would it sound weird?
lines.zh: : 为什么会怪？

lines.en: : Because my type is basically the same type of person that...you know...you are and stuff...
lines.zh: : 因为我喜欢的对象基本上跟……你知道的……你是一类人什么的……

lines.en: scene chikasunset37
: What?! Seriously?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！真的假的？！

lines.en: : That’s like...a huge surprise!
lines.zh: : 这可真是……太意外了！

lines.en: : It...is?
lines.zh: : 是……是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! I’m like, the complete opposite of you, right? Like, our styles don't match at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊！我跟你完全是相反的类型吧？我们的风格一点都不搭。

lines.en: : Maybe that whole opposites attract thing is true after all?
lines.zh: : 也许「异性相吸」那套是真的？

lines.en: : Wait a second. Umm...
lines.zh: : 等等。嗯……

lines.en: : You don’t think it’s weird that I basically just...you know...
lines.zh: : 你不觉得这很奇怪吗，我就这么……你知道的……

lines.en: : Came out to you?
lines.zh: : 跟你出柜了？

lines.en: : What? No. Why would I care about that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不。我为什么要介意那个？

lines.en: : I was more surprised that you said you were into girls like me than the fact that you're into girls to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我更惊讶的是你说喜欢的是我这种女生，而不是你喜欢女生这件事本身。

lines.en: scene chikasunset38
: So...you’re really not weirded out?
lines.zh: : 所以……你真的不觉得别扭？

lines.en: : Of course not. What year do you think it is, Rin? It's not like girl on girl relationships are unheard of.
lines.zh: : 当然不。你以为现在是什么年代啊，Rin？女生和女生谈恋爱又不是什么闻所未闻的事。

lines.en: : Like, there are tons of girls I think are super pretty.
lines.zh: : 比如我就觉得好多女生都超漂亮的。

lines.en: : Take Niki for example- I've got posters of her all over my wall and if, for some weird reason, she ever wanted to hook up with me?...Oh boy. You don't even know.
lines.zh: : 就拿妮姬来说吧——我墙上贴满了她的海报，要是出于什么奇怪的理由她想跟我搞……哦天哪。你根本想象不到。

lines.en: : I’ll admit that I've never really thought about being in a relationship with a girl...but I don’t think I’d be opposed if the right one came along.
lines.zh: : 我承认我从来没认真想过和女生交往……不过要是对的人出现了，我想我也不会排斥。

lines.en: : I’m on the side of just “go for whoever you want to go for” and if it doesn’t work out then, hey...at least you tried. You know?
lines.zh: : 我的立场就是「想追谁就追谁」，要是不成，嘿……至少你试过了。你懂吧？

lines.en: scene chikasunset39
: N-Not that I have any experience in the matter or anything like that...
lines.zh: : 当……当然我在这方面没什么经验什么的……

lines.en: : It’s just...you know...how I feel and stuff.
lines.zh: : 只是……你知道的……我的感受之类的。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: Yeah, I totally get it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我完全明白。

lines.en: : I'm really happy to hear that, actually...
lines.zh: : 其实听到你这么说，我真的很开心……

lines.en: : PAGING RIN ROKUHARA. RIN ROKUHARA, PLEASE REPORT TO THE TINY IRISH GIRL.
lines.zh: : 呼叫六原Rin。六原Rin，请前往娇小的爱尔兰女孩处报到。

lines.en: scene chikasunset40
: Huh?
: Plans tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚有安排？

lines.en: : Not as far as I can re-
lines.zh: : 我记得应该没——

lines.en: scene chikasunset41
: Oh crap! I totally do have plans tonight! I completely forgot!
lines.zh: : 哦靠！我今晚真的有安排！我完全忘了！

lines.en: : Well, don’t let me hold you up if your friends are waiting for you.
lines.zh: : 那你朋友在等你的话，我就不拦你了。

lines.en: : I think I’m gonna hang out under the moon for a little while longer anyway.
lines.zh: : 我想我还要在月光下再待一会儿。

lines.en: scene chikasunset42
: It’s really beautiful tonight, don't you think?
lines.zh: : 今晚的月亮真美，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: The moon is beautiful...
lines.zh: : 月色真美……

lines.en: If this were a happy story, a shooting star would pass over them.
lines.zh: 如果这是个幸福的故事，此刻会有一颗流星划过她们头顶。

lines.en: The girl on the left would confess her feelings to the one on the right.
lines.zh: 左边的女孩会向右边的那个告白。

lines.en: And the two of them would kiss.
lines.zh: 然后两人相吻。

lines.en: But this is not a happy story.
lines.zh: 但这不是幸福的故事。

lines.en: There are no happy stories.
lines.zh: 世上没有幸福的故事。

lines.en: And so they will break apart.
lines.zh: 所以她们终将分离。

lines.en: Just as all things do.
lines.zh: 正如万物皆然。

lines.en: But at least the moon is beautiful.
lines.zh: 但至少，月色真美。

lines.en: : RIN! WHERE THE HECK ARE YOU? WE’VE GOT DRAGONS TO SLAY.
lines.zh: : Rin！你到底在哪儿？！我们还有龙要屠呢。

lines.en: scene chikasunset43
: Jeez. Sounds like your plans are even crazier than I thought.
lines.zh: : 天哪。听起来你的安排比我想的还要疯狂。

lines.en: : Ugh...Why tonight of all nights?
lines.zh: : 唉……为什么偏偏是今晚？

lines.en: : Probs cause the dragons would kill us all if you waited until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你要是拖到明天，龙会把我们全杀了吧。

lines.en: : Please don’t add to my current embarrassment, Chika. I’m drowning enough as-is.
lines.zh: : 别再火上浇油了，Chika。我已经够难为情了。

lines.en: : Heheh...Go slay your dragons, Rin.
lines.zh: : 呵呵呵……去屠你的龙吧，Rin。

lines.en: : We can talk more tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我们明天再聊。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah...
: I’d like that.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意。
